verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document pairing a card reader with the Square POS app, registering a reader or terminal to an account, or how long it takes to reach a first payment. The available material covers adjacent capabilities only: Tap to Pay on iPhone, which works without a reader, a generic line about processing payments on Square hardware, and Terminal API tip settings. None of these shows the pairing or registration flow the story asks for.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes
